text:
rebecca: quick alert - short-embed requests (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 seeing intermittent 503s since ~02:07 UTC. p99 error spike, p95 ok. Likely regression from yesterday's quant optimization. Preparing revert image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Need expedited approvals to deploy during the maintenance window.

omar: scope? customers impacted?

rebecca: limited subset (~3% of eu-west1 traffic). A few support tickets. No DB/schema changes.

kevin: will this require cache work or warmup?

rebecca: KV prefix layout compatible, but kernel revert can cause prefix miss churn. Plan: deploy revert, then run prefix cache drain+warm on pool. Expected warmup tail ~5-10m.

rebecca: posting deploy: `/deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix --strategy canary=5%:3m --reason "short-embed 503 regression"`

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6543210000 created by rebecca. Approvals required: eng-leads + ops-oncall. Preflight: unit/integration PASS, smoke WARNING (503 observed).

ops-bot: ops rotation paged.

omar: I can approve for eng if ops watches and we do 5% canary then ramp. /approve 6543210000

kevin: approve for docs/QA; I'll draft a short support note. /approve 6543210000

ops-bot: ops-oncall (siva) acknowledged via pager. Manual ops approval pending.

siva: oncall here, approve ops conditionally: 5% canary 180s, active monitoring, rollback gate ready. /approve 6543210000

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: omar, kevin, siva. Starting canary: embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix (5% for 180s). Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6543210000

rebecca: applying image and draining subset: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Canary in progress. New pods errors 0, latency stable.

siva: canary green from traces. Ramp to 25% for 4m then full if stable.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 25% (240s).

deploy-bot: 25% window complete; errors <0.1%, p95 +2ms. Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS.

rebecca: drained prefix cache and warmed; warm-up tail ~7m, no regressions observed.

omar: thanks. Please add release note: "Embeddings: hotfix revert to v2.3.2 to address 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1. Canary ramp and prefix cache drain performed."

kevin: support blurb sent.

rebecca: filing RCA ticket for quant kernel fix. Closing thread once release note and incident link posted. :white_check_mark:
